method: Every frame is composed independently from its Seq-3 reference cell at native pixel coordinates, with the path-wing layer behind the creature and the core/effects above it. Each frame is rasterized at 4x, saved as a raw RGBA source, reduced once by integer 4x Nearest Neighbor, then placed into the sheet. No sheet is resized as a whole.

references.seq3_source: tools/art/gestalt2b/sources/seq3/ (the workspace gestalt3.zip delivery; no gestalt3b.zip was present)

style: The detailed Seq-3 creature is retained as the body and material reference. Preserve its head, silhouette, main color, texture, and 2-3 shade steps. Add 1px #1a1c2c outlined path-material wings, an amber core, top-left lighting, binary transparency, and only colors from the game player palette. No flat replacement figures, antialiasing, gradients, text, pure white, or cell-edge pixels.
style_block:
STYLE GUIDE (apply to every asset):
Top-down 3/4 perspective pixel art for a 2D mystery/investigation game, readable and clean like classic farming/life-sim pixel games, but dark and atmospheric.
Setting: an original foggy Victorian-era industrial world with occult undertones: gas lamps, soot-stained brick, wrought iron, canals, chapels, secret societies, alchemical potions.
Pixels: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; 2-3 shade steps per material, light from top-left. 1px outline #1a1c2c on the figure.
Palette: max 32 muted colors matching the reference sprite: slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white (#ebcd8d / #bbae95, never pure white); warm amber only for lamp/holy light; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet only for occult effects, sparingly.
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, dignified, slightly unsettling, never gory, never cute.
Output: TRANSPARENT background (real alpha), no text, no watermark.
Avoid: flat geometric shapes, vector look, 3D render look, painterly style, chibi, anime eyes, references to existing games or franchises.
palette: The exact visible RGB colors from battle_player.png (31 colors); source Seq-3 tones are mapped to the nearest color in this palette before any additions.

path_prompts.prompt: Keep the detailed Seq-3 brass lantern body and orbiting shoulder lamps. Open the central housing and show a pure amber flame instead of a face. Add six shaded light-ribbon wings, each ending in a little lantern flame.
Keep the detailed stitched puppet body and pale fabric. Grow harp-string wings between long needles; let the suspended strings reach to y=2, one pixel before the cell edge.
Keep the Seq-3 mask head and theater mantle. Expand the mask crown into two fans of closed-eye masks; the central face is a bright blank mirror.
Keep the blue-grey bell creature. Open the bell into a crown and add concentric sound-ring wings; trail each contour by one darker pixel.
Keep the detailed copper boiler and glowing belly. Float the lid-crown as a halo and form steam wings from hard-edged, shaded pixel clouds.
Keep the Seq-3 iron creature and its hammer arm. Fan riveted iron plates into blade wings and add a heavy forge ring with brighter amber seams.
Keep the narrow key-bearing creature. Grow two luminous open doorframes from its back shield and orbit small keys around the waist.
Keep the solemn blindfolded balance creature. Enlarge its balanced scales into disc wings and place the beam over its shoulders as a yoke.
Keep the dark bogwater body. Extend reeds and cotton-grass into wings with water held in their leaves; change the chest water-eye to a pale light.
Keep the exposed Seq-3 clockwork body and blank clock head. Add two enormous clock-hand wings, a shaded brass gear halo, and a column of amber pendulum light below.

card.grid: 4x4: front, left, right, back; 4 moving frames per direction
card.shadow: fixed at y=45-46; body hover ends at or above y=43

battle.grid: 6x6: idle, attack1, attack2, special, hurt, defeated
battle.movement: at least one frame in attack1, attack2, special and defeated changes at least 800 alpha-mask pixels from idle frame 1

frame_plan.zugbild: 32x32 crop from the new battle idle upper body; transparent one-pixel border
